subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem grandezas determinadas pela razão ou pelo produto de outras (velocidade, densidade demográfica, energia elétrica etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar grandezas definidas pela razão de duas outras grandezas em contextos reais
components.description_en: Identify quantities defined by the ratio of two other quantities in real-world contexts
components.cc_component_description: Given a rate relationship between two quantities in a real-world problem, calculate the unit rate

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo grandezas derivadas como velocidade, densidade populacional ou energia elétrica
components.description_en: Solve problems involving derived quantities such as speed, population density, or electrical energy
components.cc_component_description: Use the concept of density when solving real world problems involving area

components.description_pt: Criar problemas envolvendo grandezas definidas pela razão ou produto de outras grandezas
components.description_en: Create problems involving quantities defined by the ratio or product of other quantities

cc_matches.description: Compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions, including ratios of lengths, areas and other quantities measured in like or different units. *For example, if a person walks $\frac{1}{2}$ mile in each $\frac{1}{4}$ hour, compute the unit rate as the complex fraction $\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{1}{4}}$  miles per hour, equivalently 2 miles per hour.*
Apply concepts of density based on area and volume in modeling situations (e.g., persons per square mile, BTUs per cubic foot).
